speaker: richard_field
text: Now. The bracket gives it up. One flame. It comes back with me, so do not grow fond of it at the corner.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not grow fond of a lantern. The fold is the thing that is mine, and it is already under the cloak.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Go to the door, both of you. I am not coming into the lane to say a thing I have said in a warm room.
